notes: This is a proposed change/state matrix, not a capture manifest or final public catalog. It contains no snapshot claims.
All 25 actual release sources are listed. v0.5.0 remains provenance and the last source baseline for the legacy Bot and Analysis Reports; it is intentionally not a UI milestone.

v0.5.1 retires Bot Report and Analysis Report into Lab. Visuals remains one screen identity across the legacy asset pages and React route. The v0.3.3 Replay URL rename and v0.5.3 Privacy/Terms route migration retain their existing screen identities.

Replay default means a final-board view; analysis is settled beginning at v0.4.6. Public Player default includes its stats and catalog. Capture only the listed meaningful states; unlisted coverage is unrecorded, not evidence of absence.
Legacy account, sync, and reset states use the primary-qualified synthetic transport for v0.3.x through v0.5.4; no production accounts are used.
The v0.2.1 through v0.2.3 source locks/toolchain limitations and generated Wasm dependency remain capture receipt concerns from the inventory, not claims in this matrix.
